approvers: Site manager, project quantity surveyor, client or developer if specified
reason: I pay about €12 a m² today with film and my own lads, and you want €19 plus a 50% deposit when I pay my suppliers at 60 to 90 days. Our whole film spend is under €5,000 a year, so I can't justify a paid pilot and a new supplier file for that.
objection: It costs about 60% more than what I do now, and I can't see on paper that it saves me more in damaged glazing than the extra €7 a m². A deposit up front is a non-starter for me.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and sheet with tape applied by my own labour. I might try the OMNIGUARD supply-only option on one job if the price per m² came in below film.
would_change_my_mind: A local reference contractor showing fewer glazing claims at handover with numbers, 60-day terms with no deposit, and a total price close to €14 a m².
